mapper.sql: SELECT cntc_drcc.drcc_id , cntc_drcc.clnt_id , cntc.cntc_id , cntc.cntc_nombre , cntc.cntc_apellido_paterno , cntc.cntc_apellido_materno , cntc.cntc_fono_movil , cntc.cntc_email , cntc_drcc.ctdr_rol

SELECT drcc.drcc_id , drcc.drcc_dsc , drcc.drcc_calle , drcc.drcc_numeracion , drcc.drcc_referencia , drcc.drcc_imagen_perfil, drcc.drcc_latitud , drcc.drcc_longitud , drcc.drcc_flag_evidencia , cntc_drcc.ctdr_rol
FROM ${schema}contatos_direcciones as cntc_drcc INNER JOIN ${schema}contactos as cntc ON cntc_drcc.cntc_id = cntc.cntc_id
FROM ${schema}contatos_direcciones as cntc_drcc INNER JOIN ${schema}direcciones as drcc ON cntc_drcc.clnt_id = drcc.clnt_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${schema}contatos_direcciones (cntc_id, clnt_id, drcc_id, ctdr_rol ) VALUES (#{contacto.id}, #{cliente.id}, #{direccion.id}, #{rol})
